call_points.text: High single-digit volume growth for FY27 maintained, with volumes expected to pick up significantly in Q3 and Q4.
Coal tar distillation project definition progressing; capex approval and firm dates expected within a month or two.
Domestic carbon black volume rose 15% YoY to 102,985 tonnes; international was 50,528 tonnes after deliberate diversion to domestic spot.
Q2 volumes may be temporarily hit as customers adopt cautious procurement and destock; management calls it timing, not demand.
Freight remains high and erratic; surcharges recover most but not all of the cost, varying by customer.
Nanovace pilot plant is up; first batch of customer samples targeted in the coming weeks of August.
FY27 carbon black volume growth guided at high single-digit, with more than double-digit EBITDA growth.
Aquapharm FY27 revenue growth guided at 20-25%.
Cost initiatives target ₹200-250 Cr savings over the next 4-6 quarters.
Full cost pass-through expected by Q2FY27, with margins normalising then.
Total carbon black capacity now 880,000 tonnes per annum after 90,000-tonne Tamil Nadu expansion.
20,000-tonne specialty black line at Mudra ready, commissioning in the next few weeks.
1,000 MTPA superconductive specialty black line at Palej mechanically ready but commissioning delayed by gas shortage.
Nanovace battery chemicals pilot plant ready for commissioning; commercial volumes expected in FY28.
Net borrowings reduced by ₹454 Cr to ₹4,536 Cr in FY26 despite ₹750 Cr capex.
Incremental working capital need estimated at ₹100 Cr if crude stays at $90.
Customers shifting from just-in-time to just-in-case, adding at least 3-4 days of inventory cover.
India-EU FTA gives no direct carbon black duty benefit but could lift Indian tyre exports to Europe.

operating_notes.text: Carbon black capacity is now 880,000 tonnes per annum after a 90,000-tonne brownfield expansion in Tamil Nadu.
About 75% of raw materials are sourced from the U.S. Gulf Coast and around 40% of sales volume is exported.
Aquapharm capacity expanded from 1,30,000 tonnes to 1,67,000 tonnes during FY26.
Carbon black sales volume was 153,513 tonnes in Q1FY27, with tires at 91,379 tonnes, performance chemicals at 42,386 tonnes and specialty at 19,748 tonnes, up 23% YoY.
Power generation was 217 million units with external sales of 130 million units in Q1FY27 at realisation of ₹5.39 a unit versus ₹3.66 in Q4FY26.
Brent averaged USD 97 per barrel in Q1FY27 versus USD 78 in Q4FY26, and the CBFS-CBO price gap stayed close to USD 150 with CBO higher.

timeline.summary: On 30 April 2026 PCBL's Q4FY26 call reported revenue of ₹2,066 Cr and EBITDA of ₹248 Cr, FY26 net borrowings down ₹454 Cr to ₹4,536 Cr, and guided FY27 high single-digit volume growth with cost pass-through by Q2FY27.

On its 29 July 2026 Q1FY27 call, PCBL reported revenue up 17% to ₹2,474 Cr and PAT up 65% to ₹155 Cr, flagged ₹40-50 Cr of inventory gain to reverse, and kept FY27 EBITDA per tonne guidance at ₹16,500-17,000.
